title: Pharmacist qualifications for collaborative drug therapy management
rule_summary: A collaborating pharmacist must satisfy Massachusetts licensure, experience or degree, liability insurance, practice-focus, and additional annual continuing-education requirements.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply qualifications requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Pharmacist qualifications for collaborative drug therapy management

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing qualifications with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
